Thanks for contributing. Draft pull requests and questions are welcome.

## Summary

What changed?

## Why?

What problem does this solve, and is there a related issue or design document?

## Validation

List the relevant commands and their results. If you could not run a check,
say why.

## Checklist

- [ ] I linked related context or explained why there is no issue.
- [ ] I ran the relevant tests and checks, or described what remains.
- [ ] I updated documentation or tests when behavior changed.
- [ ] I did not add private or unlicensed assets.

## Reviewer notes

Call out compatibility changes, known limitations, or areas where you want
focused review.
